title: Doesn't stay sharp long, or keep a knife sharpener handy , but chopped herbs good!
text:
Doesn't stay sharp long, or keep a knife sharpener handy , but chopped herbs good!. I received 8 in. Chef knife.
The handle is a cheesy gray plastic that is suppose to look
Like some type of marble!

That said I used this to cut a tomato , the first two cuts did pretty good,
But after that I used a better knife too finish cutting.
But what surprise me was, I used this to chopped up fine , cilantro,
Dill, and parsley. This knife did a great job.
These knifes do not last long, but if you want to sharpen them after
Using them every other time then there worth it.

These can be used for inside a Rv, kids learning to cook etc, just
Remember take a knife sharpener with you, or give it with this knife.

Do not put this knife or any knife in the dishwasher, it dulls the knife,
And shortens the life of your knifes, besides ruining the wood or
Plastic handles.
